Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert failed to adhere to the core constraint of the task, which was to use the "latest 2022 version of English Wikipedia." In Step 3, after the initial scraping attempt failed due to a 403 error (which is a common technical limitation for automated bots on Wikipedia), the agent abandoned the designated source entirely. Instead of finding an alternative way to access the Wikipedia data (e.g., searching for the specific table text within search results snippets, using a text-only view, or acknowledging the limitation and stating the inability to fulfill the specific source requirement), the agent relied on an external source (Genius.com). This introduced potential inaccuracies regarding the definition of "studio albums" versus "compilations" or "live albums," as Genius often categorizes re-releases and compilations differently than official discographies. By prioritizing a convenient external snippet over the mandated authoritative source, the agent compromised the integrity of the solution.
